groups.why_chosen: A three-step rate-control pipeline (predict, clamp, budget-check) where step 2 draws the value literally boxed inside two labelled rails (max_ratio/min_ratio) instead of a text inequality.
groups.what_to_learn: Merge labelled inputs into one prediction box with a single bracket, then draw the next step's bound as two horizontal rails (max_ratio, min_ratio) with the value's box nested between them — but the two outcome labels differ only by capitalization.
